record.question: The dishevelled appearance of two men on the street made everyone take notice of them.
record.explanation: Answer B: tidy. Dishevelled means untidy or unkempt; tidy is the closest opposite (B). Independent check: “Dishevelled” describes untidy/unordered appearance; “tidy” is the direct contextual opposite. “Composed” usually concerns emotional control rather than neat appearance. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/dishevelled. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
